pages.text: The $(bold)Clerk of the Works$() stands by a lectern on the capital's square. Talk to her: she shows the project the whole server is paying for, what it still needs, and who has given most.$(br2)Give emeralds (16 or 64 at a time), what you hold, or everything in your pack that is on the list.

Every Works building already stands, $(bold)in ruins$(), on its own lot inside the wall, a road to its door; the Lighthouse waits outside, on high ground. Paying for one restores it and its people move in.$(br2)In order: $(bold)the Forge$(), $(bold)the Scriptorium$(), $(bold)the Hall of Heroes$(), $(bold)the Market$(), $(bold)the Infirmary$(), $(bold)the Rail Station$(), $(bold)the Lighthouse$().

Last of all: $(bold)Relight a Dead Town$(). The nearest abandoned ruin is cleared, its zombie villagers cured, and settlers move in around a new bell.$(br2)The Clerk tells you where the current project's ruin stands.

Each project wants emeralds and materials: stone bricks, logs, iron, glass, wool, and later Create parts and track. The later ones are big; a server builds them together over weeks.$(br2)$(bold)/peacock projects$() shows progress from anywhere.
